title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Marcin Wise Chat…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Marcin Wise Chat versions up to 3.4.5. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.1 (CVSS 3.1).
